name: Theramore Isle
summary: Theramore Isle shelters refugees from Lordaeron behind the eastern coast of Dustwallow Marsh. Lady Jaina Proudmoore founded the fortified port, now the Alliance's chief stronghold in southern Kalimdor.

sections.title: Refuge of the West
sections.body:
After the Scourge ravaged Dalaran and Lordaeron in the Third War, Lady Jaina Proudmoore led survivors across the Great Sea to Kalimdor. There, humans, dwarves, and high elves fought beside orcs and night elves to defeat the Burning Legion atop Mount Hyjal.

After the victory, Jaina's coalition withdrew to the misty edge of Dustwallow Marsh. On an island just off the coast, they raised a harbor city with stone ramparts and Jaina's citadel, sheltering what remained of the northern kingdoms.

sections.title: An Uneasy Peace
sections.body:
Theramore's peace with Thrall's Horde in neighboring Durotar has long been uneasy. When Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore arrived with the Kul Tiras fleet, he took command of the isle and began a campaign against the orcs.

Jaina would not let hatred undo Kalimdor's hard-won survival. She allowed the Horde to kill her father within Theramore's walls to preserve the peace. The city now holds a fragile truce with Durotar, though veteran sailors' resentment threatens to break it.

faq.answer: Lady Jaina Proudmoore governs Theramore Isle. A master sorceress from Dalaran and Kul Tiras, she led Lordaeron's survivors to Kalimdor during the Third War. She oversees the city's defenses and diplomacy.

faq.q: Why did humans build a city in a swamp?
aliases: why is theramore in a marsh
faq.answer: After the Battle of Mount Hyjal, the surviving human expedition needed a defensible coast to shelter its people and keep a navy. The rocky island off Dustwallow Marsh offered deep-water anchorage and separation from mainland threats, despite the bog surrounding it.

faq.q: Is Theramore hostile to the Horde?
faq.answer: Theramore is an Alliance stronghold, and its guards meet Horde travelers with hostility. Yet Lady Jaina Proudmoore and Warchief Thrall keep an uneasy peace and respect each other's borders, despite lingering hatred among their people.

faq.q: What happened to Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore here?
faq.answer: Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore took Theramore from his daughter Jaina to make war on the young Horde. Seeing that his campaign would destroy them all, Jaina stepped aside as Thrall and Rexxar stormed the citadel and killed the Admiral in battle.

angles.text: Theramore Isle is the Alliance's chief seat of power in central Kalimdor. It offers safety, ferry connections, and a defended harbor amid hostile wilderness.
As Archmage Jaina Proudmoore's home, Theramore holds powerful arcane conduits. It is a vital center of Kirin Tor tradition and teleportation in the western hemisphere.
